title: The Hidden Light
summary: "Hataras nedarim porchin ba'avir": annulling vows hangs in the air, and some halachos are like mountains hanging by a hair, with a word on how spoken words never disappear. Then what may not be taught in public, why we may not ask what is above and below, Adam who reached from earth to heaven, the ten things created on the first day, the green line around the world, and the first light, hidden away for the tzaddikim.
key_ideas: Words never disappear; they hover in the air, so a person must be careful with every word.
Some depths of Torah are taught only one on one, to someone who can understand on his own.
Adam contained all of humanity, and at first could see from one end of the world to the other.
The first light was hidden for the tzaddikim, and it can be reached through the Torah.
